plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 19 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 99, Soo River FSR.
Park: 50.2331, -123.05372, pull off on Soo River FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 80 m S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-11, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-duck-drive-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 2-11: about 3,307 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.98 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
